name: procurement-system-root
description: Root convenience scripts for running the whole project locally in one step - see LOCAL_DEMO.md. Not used by Render or Vercel, which each deploy backend/ and frontend/ independently.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
